newsitem.title: FRANCE: Top Paris jeweller falls for suitcase of fake cash.
newsitem.headline: Top Paris jeweller falls for suitcase of fake cash.

text.p: Swindlers have bought 24 million francs ($4.5 million) worth of jewels from a top Paris jeweller with forged mark banknotes, police sources said on Monday.
Claiming to act for a wealthy foreigner requesting anonymity, the thieves arranged a meeting in a specially-rented lounge at a smart Paris hotel last Friday.
They handed over a suitase full of 1,000-mark banknotes in return for the jewels case and had vanished by the time the bank told the jeweller the notes were forged.
The sources declined to identify the jeweller but said his offices were on Place Vendome, where the French capital's most famed jewelry companies have their headquarters.
